description: This file defines the BodyParsingMiddleware class for the Slim Framework, handling HTTP request body parsing for different media types such as JSON, XML, and form data.

classes.name: BodyParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for parsing HTTP request bodies based on content type, supporting JSON, XML, and form data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with optional custom body parsers and registers default parsers.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, parsing the body if necessary, and passes it to the next handler.

methods.name: registerBodyParser
methods.description: Registers a custom body parser for a specific media type.

methods.name: hasBodyParser
methods.description: Checks if a parser exists for a given media type.

methods.name: getBodyParser
methods.description: Retrieves the parser callable for a specific media type, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: registerDefaultBodyParsers
methods.description: Registers default parsers for JSON, URL-encoded, and XML media types.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the request body based on its media type using the registered parser.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Extracts the media type from the request's Content-Type header.

methods.name: disableXmlEntityLoader
methods.description: Disables or enables XML entity loader based on libxml version.
